narrative:
Your application was denied because the model estimated a 56.0% chance that you would be a bad credit risk. In practical terms, the model judged that bad repayment was slightly more likely than good repayment, so the application did not meet the bank’s approval threshold.

You should ask the bank to confirm the credit-history entry and correct it if it is inaccurate.
